rationale: The Domain Legal Reranker (+0.35 section, +0.25 intent, +0.20 token overlap, +0.15 jurisdiction) achieves the highest Precision@1 (90.0%), Recall@3 (100.0%), and MRR (0.933) with sub-millisecond latency (<0.2ms). Because the SahyogSetu legal knowledge base contains 33 verified statutory chunks, training a deep cross-encoder on this corpus is severely data-sparse, risks catastrophic overfitting to training terms, and increases CPU inference latency by >40ms without measurable precision improvement.
